name: BD-72
description: BD-72 was a repurposed vintage BD explorer droid owned by Peli Motto on Tatooine during the New Republic Era. The droid assisted Din Djarin and Peli Motto with the construction of Din Djarin's N-1 starfighter. His motivational firmware had a deeply programmed curiosity meant for his task as an explorer droid. As a repair assistant he used it to eagerly find the best ways to use his varied equipment to help his fellow mechanics.
